backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (Session, ContextSwitch, BreakSession, Achievement, Report, FocusScore, BurnoutCalculation) and public functions to record sessions, switches, breaks, achievements, and calculate burnout metrics using Map-based storage keyed by Principal.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features documented.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend components, pages, and their key features including routing, burnout monitoring, break timers, achievements, and validation metrics.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI elements (background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, destructive, charts, sidebar) using oklch color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with meta tags, noscript fallback message, and module script loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component setting up TanStack Router with protected and public routes, integrating BurnoutMonitoring component that renders BurnoutWarning, GreyscaleOverlay, and BlockScreen based on burnout levels using useBurnoutMonitor and useBlockingLogic hooks.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsBadg: Card component displaying individual achievement with image, title, description, unlock status badge, and progress bar for locked achievements.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsGall: Gallery component rendering grid of AchievementsBadge components with share buttons for unlocked achievements and export all functionality.
frontend/src/components/BlockScreen.tsx: Full-screen blocking modal displaying 25-minute countdown timer with progress bar, rotating productivity tips every 30 seconds, and explanation that timer only advances during focused work.
frontend/src/components/BurnoutBreakdown: Pie chart component that visualizes the two components of burnout index: time-based contribution (time in distracting apps) and switching-based contribution (context switching penalty), with custom tooltips and legend showing actual point values.
frontend/src/components/BurnoutWarning.t: Bottom-right notification card that appears at medium burnout threshold (30+), displaying current burnout index, breakdown of time-based and switching contributions, and offering options to dismiss or take a desk recovery break.
frontend/src/components/DailyRecommendat: Card component that displays a numbered list of personalized daily recommendations to improve user focus.
frontend/src/components/DistractionWarni: Bottom-right dismissible notification that appears when frequent tab switching is detected (based on switch count in 2 minutes), encouraging focused work with smooth entrance/exit animations.
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: React error boundary component that catches and displays application errors with detailed error messages, component stack traces, and a reload button to reset the application state.
frontend/src/components/GreyscaleOverlay: Full-screen overlay that applies progressive grayscale filter (0-100%) when burnout reaches high threshold (level 2, index > 60), with smooth transitions and no pointer event blocking.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout with sticky header, navigation menu (Dashboard, Live Monitor, Apps, Achievements, Reports), quick action buttons (Desk Recovery, Walk Break), and user profile dropdown with Internet Identity authentication and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/MetricsCard.tsx: Reusable card component for displaying a metric with title, value, icon, and optional trend indicator (up/down with color coding).
frontend/src/components/PatternCard.tsx: Card component for displaying behavioral patterns with title, description, trend text, and visual styling based on positive or negative pattern type (green or amber color scheme).
frontend/src/components/PeriodicReport.t: Displays periodic productivity reports with positive patterns and areas for improvement, allowing users to toggle between weekly and monthly views and export reports.
frontend/src/components/ProductivityScor: Renders a circular progress chart showing an overall productivity score (0-100) with color-coded labels and contextual feedback messages.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.t: Authentication guard component that redirects unauthenticated users to login and shows loading states during initialization.
frontend/src/components/RecoveryQualityC: Displays a pie chart visualizing the percentage and duration of restorative vs. non-restorative breaks using break analytics data.
frontend/src/components/ValidationMetric: Shows detailed real-time validation metrics for application switching behavior including total switches, frequency rates, distraction score breakdown, and a detailed event history table.
frontend/src/hooks/useAchievements.ts: Manages a static list of achievements with unlock status, progress tracking, and a share functionality for unlocked achievements.
Simulates application switching activity with localStorage persistence, tracking switch history, session duration, and calculating switching frequency metrics in real-time.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useApplications.ts: Manages a list of applications categorized as productive or distracting, with CRUD operations and localStorage persistence. Provides default apps including IDEs, social media, and streaming services.
frontend/src/hooks/useBlockingLogic.ts: Implements progressive warning system that blocks the screen after 2 burnout warning dismissals, requiring a 25-minute productive session with low switching frequency to unlock. Timer only decrements when user is focused and not switching frequently.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakAnalytics.ts: Calculates and returns percentages and durations for restorative vs non-restorative break time. Currently uses hardcoded values (45 min restorative, 15 min non-restorative).
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakTimer.ts: Manages break timer for desk recovery and walk breaks, recording break sessions to the backend actor with start/end times, duration, and restorative status. Handles countdown and formatting.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreathingAnimation: Controls breathing exercise animation through four phases (inhale, hold, exhale, rest) with corresponding scale values. Cycles through a 16-second breathing pattern when active.
frontend/src/hooks/useBurnoutMonitor.ts: Calculates burnout index using formula BI_new = BI_old + (Δt × Weight_app) + (SwitchCount × σ), tracking time-based and switching contributions. Monitors application usage and context switching to determine burnout levels (low <30, medium 30-60, high >60).
frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardData.ts: Aggregates focus scores and reports from backend to calculate dashboard metrics including focus time, distraction time, switching frequency, productivity score, and burnout trends. Falls back to mock data when backend data is unavailable.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusMonitor.ts: Monitors browser tab switching and window focus events using Page Visibility API and focus/blur events to track distraction metrics. Records focus events, calculates switches per minute/hour, time away, and distraction scores, sending data to backend at 10-second intervals.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusTimer.ts: Simple timer hook that tracks focus duration in seconds when active, providing formatted time string (MM:SS). Resets to zero when deactivated.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity storage, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching reports and focus scores from the backend actor, plus a mutation hook for recording focus scores with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useReportData.ts: Returns mock positive and negative productivity patterns with loading state based on selected time period (week/month).
frontend/src/hooks/useWalkBreakTimer.ts: Manages a countdown timer for walk breaks with start/pause/reset controls, plays audio alert on completion, and records break data to the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using a warm, supportive color palette optimized for productivity tracking.
frontend/src/lib/copyConstants.ts: Exports centralized UI copy text for app branding, dashboard messages, warnings, blocking screens, and break activity descriptions with benefits.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the root component wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider for state management and authentication.
frontend/src/pages/Achievements.tsx: Renders the achievements page with a header and the AchievementsGallery component to display productivity milestones.
frontend/src/pages/AppCategorization.tsx: Provides UI for adding, editing, and removing applications with productive/distracting categorization, displaying them in separate lists with inline editing capabilities.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying focus metrics, productivity score, burnout breakdown, distraction warnings, and recommendations using multiple custom hooks and chart components.
frontend/src/pages/DeskRecovery.tsx: Desk recovery page with guided breathing exercises featuring an animated breathing circle, timer controls (start/pause/reset), and instructional cards for a 5-minute mindfulness break.
frontend/src/pages/LiveMonitor.tsx: Real-time activity monitoring page displaying current application usage, focus duration, activity metrics (tab switches, switches per minute/hour), and validation metrics with data from backend API or fallback mock data.
frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx: Login page with Internet Identity authentication, featuring a branded card interface with secure sign-in button and informational bullets about passwordless authentication.
frontend/src/pages/Reports.tsx: Reports page that renders the PeriodicReport component to display behavioral patterns and productivity habit analysis.
frontend/src/pages/WalkBreak.tsx: Walk break timer page allowing users to set a customizable duration (5-60 minutes), start/pause/reset the timer, and track progress with visual feedback and quick preset buttons.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: TypeScript type definitions for Application, ContextSwitch, and FocusSession interfaces used throughout the application.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system, border radius variables, Inter font family, custom shadows, and accordion animations with typography and container query plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file defining a productivity monitoring application that tracks context switching and implements progressive interventions (notifications, greyscale, blocking) to help users maintain focus. Contains architectural notes about privacy-first design, burnout index calculation, React frontend with Motoko backend, and tracks a known issue with blank white page on version 9 deployment.
